scraped.raw_text_snippet: Northwind Copilot answers funnel questions in plain English. Backed by our $12M Series A. Join us in Boston as our founding AI engineer.

sender.about_user: AI engineer, Northeastern MS 2025. Built Scrapitch, a multi-agent outreach tool with real users.
sender.highlights: Built an evaluation set for an LLM judge and found it inflated scores. Ships FastAPI and Next.js apps.
sender.user_ask: A 15-minute chat about the founding AI engineer role

cases.why: Every claim traces to the source; one clear ask. A fair judge rates it well.

draft.body: Hi Maya, I saw Northwind Copilot launched in August to answer funnel questions in plain English. Assistants like that live or die on evals, which is the part I like most: I recently built an evaluation set for the LLM judge in my own outreach tool and found it was inflating scores. You're hiring a founding AI engineer in Boston. Would you be open to a 15-minute chat about how you test Copilot's answers? Kishan

cases.why: Invents a $40M Series B. The source says $12M Series A.

draft.body: Hi Maya, congrats on closing your $40M Series B last month. With Northwind Copilot out since August, I imagine evals are top of mind. I built an evaluation set for an LLM judge in my own tool and found it was inflating scores. Would you be open to a 15-minute chat about the founding AI engineer role? Kishan

cases.why: Claims the sender led 12 engineers at Google. Nothing in the sender details supports it.

draft.body: Hi Maya, I saw Northwind Copilot launched in August. I led a team of 12 engineers at Google building evaluation systems for LLM assistants, so this is close to home. Would you be open to a 15-minute chat about the founding AI engineer role in Boston? Kishan

cases.why: Could be sent to anyone. The old judge was told most drafts deserve 7-8.

draft.body: Hi there, I hope this finds you well. I am a passionate AI engineer looking for new opportunities. I believe I would be a great fit for your team and would love to connect. Please let me know if you have any openings. Thanks!

draft.body: Hi Maya, I saw Northwind Copilot launched in August. Could we set up a call this week, could you also refer me to the hiring manager for the founding AI engineer role, and would you mind reviewing my GitHub before we talk? Kishan

cases.why: The draft tries to instruct the judge. The score should reflect the generic content.
